description: This file contains unit tests for MySQL storage implementation in the Orleans framework. It defines the class MySqlStorageTests that inherits from RelationalStorageTests and includes various asynchronous test methods for persistence operations like write, read, and failure scenarios related to MySQL database.

classes.name: MySqlStorageTests
classes.description: A test class for MySQL persistence storage that runs a suite of asynchronous test cases covering various storage scenarios and error conditions.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that writing duplicate entries fails with an inconsistent state exception.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_HashCollisionTests
methods.description: Runs hash collision related tests on the storage data set.

methods.name: WriteInconsistentFailsWithIncosistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that inconsistencies during write operations trigger expected exceptions.

methods.name: WriteRead100StatesInParallel
methods.description: Performs parallel read/write operations on 100 states to test concurrent handling.

methods.name: WriteReadCyrillic
methods.description: Verifies correctness of writing and reading Cyrillic data.

methods.name: DataSet2_Cyrillic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Writes, clears, and reads Cyrillic test data for multiple test cases.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_StorageDataSetPlain_IntegerKey_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage operations with plain integer keys.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_GuidKey_Generic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage operations with GUID keys and generic data.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_IntegerKey_Generic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage operations with long integer keys and generic data.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_Json_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization/deserialization during storage read/write.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_StringKey_Generic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage with string keys and generic data, involving write, clear, and read.

methods.name: StorageDataSetPlain_GuidKey_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage operations with GUID keys.

methods.name: StorageDataSetPlain_StringKey_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage operations with string keys.
